# BuidlGuidl

> BuidlGuidl is a long-term technical partner to the Ethereum Foundation and teams across the ecosystem. We build and maintain Scaffold-ETH 2 (the Ethereum dapp starter kit) and Speedrun Ethereum (learn to build on Ethereum through hands-on challenges), plus open source tooling and education programs.

## Tools
- [Scaffold-ETH 2](https://scaffoldeth.io): open source toolkit for building Ethereum dapps, with RainbowKit, Wagmi, Viem, NextJS, and TypeScript. Docs at https://docs.scaffoldeth.io
- [Speedrun Ethereum](https://speedrunethereum.com): learn to build on Ethereum by completing hands-on Solidity challenges, from a simple NFT to a full DEX

## Site
- [Home](https://buidlguidl.com/): products, tools, and education for the Ethereum ecosystem
- [Projects](https://buidlguidl.com/projects): the open source tools, apps, and education programs we build and maintain
- [Blog](https://buidlguidl.com/blog): writing from the BuidlGuidl team on tooling, education, and research
- [Batches](https://buidlguidl.com/batches): a program for builders who have completed Speedrun Ethereum, the next step toward open source dApp development
